prose: Reality Bender, life coach, nutrition guide and YouTube podcaster Emily Moyer joins InnerVerse for a free flow exploration of existential ideas. We delve into technocracy, alchenomics, akashic watchers, targeted individuals, guardians of the threshold, and unity consciousness pattern recognition.
ext: We share our love of underground electronic music culture, ponder the popularity of dissociative identity disorder in media, muse on the multiverse meme, look at the layers of infinite Self, and finish strong on paradoxical particle accelerators, the psychic labyrinth, & much more.
dropped: in the block (Spirit Whirled audiobook narrated by Chance)
